entities.name: Vorik
entities.description: Human captain of the Sea Gate militia who became commander-general of the Zendikari troops; died of Eldrazi corruption.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: City where Vorik established a camp during the final assault.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Planeswalker who helped Vorik bring survivors to Sky Rock and became his successor.

entities.name: Sky Rock
entities.description: Floating hedron where the survivors were brought.

entities.name: Tazri
entities.description: General and Vorik's most trusted advisor, passed over as successor.

entities.name: Rise of the Eldrazi
entities.description: Event after which Vorik became commander-general.

events.summary: Vorik's camp at Sea Gate is overwhelmed by the Eldrazi; he leads the survivors out of the ravine.
events.quote: Vorik led the survivors out of the ravine

events.summary: Gideon Jura helps the injured Vorik bring the survivors to Sky Rock.
events.quote: Gideon Jura helped the injured commander to bring the survivors to Sky Rock

events.summary: Vorik, corrupted by wounds from Ulamog's spawn, names Gideon his successor before dying.
events.quote: Before dying, he named Gideon his successor

relations.quote: Gideon Jura helped the injured commander
General Tazri , his most trusted advisor
